sections.text_helper: Section 25.3.2 "EXTI wake-up interrupt list" in chapter 25 (Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1128.
sections.section_content:
The wake-up sources are listed in the table below. Peripherals able to generate wake-up or
interrupt events are connected to the EXTI.
All wake-up sources are able to generate en event to the CPU. The EXTI CPU wake-up
signals are connected. They are used to wake up the system, and CPU subsystem
busclocks.
For CPU interrupt handling, see Section24: Nested vectored interrupt controller (NVIC).
